standard_prerequisites.use: Smooth-local character of the Gorenstein property for maps of spaces, openness of the Gorenstein locus for flat lfp morphisms of schemes (cited More on Morphisms lemma of the same name), topological facts that etale maps of spaces are open and surjective open maps reflect open subsets.

core_obligations: Pass to an etale scheme chart and the induced presentation of the source.
Apply the schemes openness theorem to the chart.
Descend openness along the surjective open map |X_V| -> |X|.
difficulty_reason: For a morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces locally of finite presentation over S which is flat, the set of points where f is Gorenstein is open in |X|; the author reduces to the corresponding schemes-side openness through an etale chart of Y and a scheme presentation of X over it. The retained proof is written: take a scheme V etale surjective over Y, base change to X_V, the property of being Gorenstein is smooth-local on source and target so |X_V| -> |X| is an open map reflecting the locus, the schemes-side result (cited More on Morphisms lemma: flat lfp morphism, Gorenstein locus open) gives the openness in X_V, and openness descends along the surjective open map of spaces. The proof's commutative square appears without an inline gloss of its universal property, but every logical step names its input lemma; the omission is typographical, not a hidden argument. Retained author proof at lines 6720-6737.
